items.title: RTX (RTX) Lands Next Generation Nuclear Cruise Missile Work For The Navy
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon won a U.S. Navy contract to progress a next generation, submarine launched nuclear cruise missile program. The award advances early development work on the missile system, aimed at launch from U.S. Navy attack submarines. The program is expected to draw on a broader industrial base, including smaller specialist suppliers in advanced propulsion and guidance.
